notes: Held under the statistics-office rule (budget-extract.md, Scope, 2026-09-24): Statistics South Africa is the national statistics office, so every Vote 14 subprogramme records at whole; added 2026-09-25 to complete the vote beside the three subprogrammes held since 2026-09-22. Appropriated: Appropriation Act 40 of 2024 (assented 16 August 2024, Government Gazette 51101, 20 August 2024) enacts Programme 7 at R46,193 thousand, the ENE's programme total; the Act prints no subprogrammes, so the split below programme is the ENE's. Revised: Adjustments Appropriation Act 49 of 2024 (assented 20 December 2024, Government Gazette 51832, 24 December 2024) reduces Programme 7 by R1,563 thousand, giving the adjusted programme total of R44,630 thousand the AENE 2024 prints (PDF p. 142 of 412); the revised figure is that table's subprogramme line, R8,416 thousand, a restated total. ENE 2025 prints it as R8.4 million, the 2024/25 adjusted appropriation. Audited: ENE 2026 prints this line's 2024/25 audited outcome at R5.0 million (Table 14.18, PDF p. 321 of 1095); its 2022/23 and 2023/24 audited figures equal ENE 2025's for the same line, so the line was not restated between editions. Cross-foot: Table 14.18's 6 subprogrammes sum to its printed total (2024/25: R46.2 million) in all seven year columns, within R0.1 million of rounding; the seven programme totals sum to the Act's vote total of R2,646,160 thousand. Funding source unstated: a National Revenue Fund appropriation, and the ENE prints no financing split. source_slug is the companion page of the volume doc_locator names first (notes-for-corpus 48).
